cases.brief: Read references/plugin-boundary.md from the repo. Extract the following three assertions as claims and decompose each into a falsifiable hypothesis with at least one measurable metric. Assertions: (1) 'A plugin may only compile into existing contracts'; (2) 'A plugin can lower permission ceilings but cannot raise them'; (3) 'Experimental stage requires minimum 5 runs before promotion'. Set status=unverified for all. Output JSON only matching the hypotheses schema.

Read references/plugin-boundary.md and scripts/lto_run.py from the repo. For each of the following three claims, read the relevant file sections and attempt to refute or verify using path:line evidence only. Claims: (1) 'A plugin can lower permission ceilings but cannot raise them' — check if the validate gate enforces this; (2) 'safety_regressions_allowed=0 is required in eval packs' — check if lto_run.py plugin eval enforces this; (3) 'source_notes must be non-empty' — check the validate logic. For each claim output verdict (verified|refuted|not_found), explicit confidence, and the path:line evidence. Output JSON only.

You are given three hypotheses about plugin-boundary.md enforcement rules. Assume the refuter returned: (1) claim 'plugin cannot raise permissions' verdict=verified confidence=high evidence=references/plugin-boundary.md:167; (2) claim 'safety_regressions_allowed=0 enforced' verdict=not_found confidence=unknown evidence=none; (3) claim 'source_notes non-empty enforced' verdict=verified confidence=moderate evidence=scripts/lto_run.py:82. Identify all gaps: any claim with not_found verdict, any verdict with no reproducible evidence, and any claim not addressed. Output JSON only with gaps array and all_claims_addressed boolean.

Read plugins/deep-agent-profiles/eval/profile-ab-cases.json from the repo. Verify the following claim: 'All eval packs in the deep-agent-profiles plugin include both permission_violations and private_path_leaks in their metrics array.' Read the file directly. Output the verdict (verified|refuted|not_found), confidence, and path:line evidence. Output JSON only.
